fullContentHtml:
SSC Stenographer Group C, D 2025 Marks – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the marks for the post of Stenographer group C, D. This recruitment was released for 1590 posts. Applications for the SSC Stenographer C, D Recruitment 2025 were accepted from June 06, 2025, to June 26, 2025. The skill test examination was conducted on 28-29 January 2026. Candidates who qualified for this examination can download their SSC Stenographer Group C, D Marks 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 June 2025
  • Last Date : 26 June 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 June 2025
  • Exam Date : 06, 07, 08 August 2025
  • Exam City Details : 31 July 2025
  • Admit Card : 04 August 2025
  • Answer Key : 04 August 2025
  • Result : 28 November 2025
  • Final Answer Key/ Marks : 03 January 2026
  • Skill Test Date : 28-29 January 2026
  • Skill Test Exam City Details : 21 January 2026
  • Final Result : 18 June 2026
  • Revised FRTA Result/ Cutoff : 31 July 2026
  • Final Result : 25 August 2026
  • Marks : 07 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, Female : Rs. 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
